name: Party DPS Meter
author: Drandox
description: Shows ranked party damage, percentage of total damage, and DPS.
longDescription:
Ranks party members by total enemy damage and shows each player's damage share and DPS. DPS averages five-second windows that start with an enemy hit. Damage to scenery is excluded.

Drag the meter to move it or drag a bottom corner to resize it. The mod saves its layout. Press **Ctrl+Shift+U** to turn the meter on or off. You can rebind it in Settings → Controls. The mod remembers whether it was on. Turning it off clears the current totals. Tracking resumes from zero when enabled again.

[Dungeon Minimap](https://github.com/Drandoxy/DRH-Mod-Dungeon-Minimap) is optional and uses matching player colors.
